text:
Aisha: quick heads-up — I'm delayed at the airport, ETA to my desk ~12:00 UTC tomorrow. I need someone to cover primary for 08:00-12:00 UTC. I can do secondary/shadowing from mobile but prefer not to be primary while traveling. Sorry for the short notice :grimacing:

Marco: I can take the primary slot, FYI I have a client call at 09:15-09:45 but will be reachable. do we want me to do a full handoff checklist or just a quick notes drop?

Aisha: thanks @Marco, quick checklist please. major points: ongoing embedding pager earlier (see incident summary below), runbook links, any active canaries, and fallback model pinned. leaving the KV-cache eviction note too.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2026-03-15-EMBEDS — Pager at 2026-03-14T21:22Z (sev3) for intermittent 504s on embeddings-read. Root cause: overloaded quantized-worker pool on node-gpu-12 during a large batch job. Mitigation: applied temporary burst policy to discrete pool and scaled pool by +2 instances. Customer impact: ~2-3% of requests saw delays >3s for a 20m window. Postmortem pending.

Priya: tagging runbook excerpt below — copy paste during handoff if helpful. also note the fallback routing policy (region fallback) is enabled.

Priya: ```
# Primary handoff quick checklist
- Confirm on-call rotation status at https://console.redwood/ops/oncall
- Check active incidents: /incidents list | grep EMBEDS
- Verify model routing: curl -sS https://api.redwood/routing/status | jq .embeds
- Ensure fallback model pinned: model=embed-approx-v2
- KV-cache check: redis-cli -h cache-prod info | grep used_memory
- If latency spike: toggle burst policy -> POST /ops/policy/burst?pool=embeds
```

Marco: got it. I'll grab primary. few notes: I'll enable extra logging for batcher at 08:10, watch the 1m P90, and leave a canary at 08:30 for eu-west. Leaving alert thresholds at p95>2000ms.

Ben: passing quick FYI — if you need immediate rollback path for quantized-worker, use: `kubectl -n embeds scale deployment/quantized-worker --replicas=0` then re-scale to 4. runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.local/embeds-quantized -> includes the emergency scale commands.

Aisha: thx @Ben. also leaving a note about tokenization mismatch we hit earlier — if you see a sudden jump in tokenization errors check model-mapper version (v1.4.2) and revert to v1.4.1 if needed.

Marco: confirming: I'll be primary 08:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow. @Priya can you be my secondary from 08:30-12:00? want a second set of eyes on the canary at 08:30.

Priya: yep I can be secondary 08:30-12:00. I'll monitor the canary and be ready to take full primary if something comes up. :thumbsup:

Aisha: appreciate it. leaving a short delegation note for the ops logs: "Aisha -> Marco (primary 08-12 UTC), Priya (secondary 08:30-12 UTC). Travel delay. Embeds pager earlier; mitigation applied. See runbook: https://console.redwood/runbooks/embeds-handoff"

ops-bot: SCHEDULE UPDATE: On-call rotation updated: primary=Marco (08:00-12:00 UTC), secondary=Priya (08:30-12:00 UTC). Hand-off note saved to /oncall/notes/6177777777.

Marco: I'll post a short status update at 08:05 and again at the 08:30 canary check. If anyone wants to shadow earlier ping me here.

Aisha: quick reminder — if a paged incident escalates to sev2, follow the escalation steps in the main runbook and call the duty director. phone chain is in the runbook. thanks all. :wave:
